messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — noticed a regression on per-token latencies for long-context chat routes this morning. Samples show a kernel swap and then a series of KV cache misses around token 24. Posting one trace below.

aj: can you paste the trace id / short dump?

maria: trace: trace-9fc2
maria: timeline snippet:
```
00:00.000 request recv
00:00.010 token 0 compile/select kernel A
00:00.050 token 24 kernel swap -> kernel B
00:00.090 kv lookup miss spike (50ms)
00:00.160 token 25 emit
```

eli: hmm, kernel swap at token 24 is weird — that suggests the kernel chooser saw a different seq len distribution after batching. Could be batching heuristics or a late re-compilation decision.

devon: adding: we recently enabled micro-batching threshold=16 for the low-latency policy on that route. Might be a boundary case where the batching window caused a mixed-batch that triggered kernel B (quantized path).

aj: do we have the per-token kernel selection metric enabled for that deployment? If not, we should add an anchor point for correlation.

maria: yes, we have token_kernel_choice and kv_hit boolean metrics but currently they're separate metrics pushed to metrics-collector with only request_id tag. The problem is joining at dashboard time — we need per-request anchors to jump to traces.

eli: proposal: emit a deterministic trace-anchor marker event (anchor_id) in the span at the time of kernel selection and KV lookup. Then attach anchor_id as tag on the metrics lines for that request. That way the per-token latency chart can link directly to the trace span.

devon: +1. Implementation note: keep anchor emission cheap: an integer counter and put it in the x-trace header, not a full log. We already have a light-weight span annotation API on the runtime.

aj: for dashboards, we should surface a collapsed per-request view: token timeline (kernel choices, kv hit/miss, micro-batch size) and a direct link to full trace. The link needs anchor_id -> trace search.

maria: wrote a quick sketch of the metric tag flow:
```
// at request start: request_id=R, anchor_id=sha1(R|start_ts)
emit_metric("request_start", {request_id, anchor_id})
// per-token: emit_metric("token_event", {request_id, anchor_id, token_idx, kernel, kv_hit})
// kernel selection span: span.annotate("anchor", anchor_id)
```

eli: looks good. One more: record batch composition at the token_event so we can see mixed-batch boundaries (batch_size, batch_members). That explains kernel swaps. But batch_members could be large — only record a compact hash or size and a small sample.

devon: about kv attribution: we should break down KV latency into local-prefetch vs remote fetch. Current kv_hit boolean is too coarse. If remote fetch spikes, dashboard should show prefetch miss and remote latency bucket.

aj: agree. Add kv_phase tag: {local_lookup, prefetch, remote_fetch}. Also capture kv_latency_ms as a histogram with request_id+anchor.

maria: question for infra-bot — is it expensive to add these anchor tags at high QPS?

infra-bot: deploy-check: adding a 16-byte anchor tag per metric is estimated +3% cardinality and +2.8% ingestion cost for the stream. No alerting impact expected.

eli: acceptable. Next: dashboards. I'll add a new per-route panel that shows: median per-token latency banded, stacked kernel usage by token_idx, KV miss rate by token_idx, and a clickable token row that opens trace at anchor.

devon: can we also add a regression alert? e.g., if kernel_swap_rate or avg token latency for tokens 16-32 increases 15% over baseline for 10m, trigger perf-alert.

aj: yes. We'll attach a runbook: how to check whether batching heuristics caused it, steps to repro with a synthetic workload and toggles to force batch boundaries.

maria: I'll generate a small repro harness: seq lengths 40-80, bursty arrival, policy low-latency threshold=16. Will run on staging and capture metrics+traces with anchor flow.

eli: thanks. Can someone own the PR for anchor emission + metric tagging? I can review the dashboard wiring.

maria: I'll submit the PR for the runtime changes tomorrow morning. Title: runtime: emit trace_anchor + per-token tags for kernel/kv attribution.

aj: I'll create the dashboard issue and add the alert rule.

devon: I'll prepare the repro harness and bench script.

maria: summary: implement anchor tag in runtime (maria), dashboard & alerts (aj), repro harness (devon), dashboard review (eli). Follow-up sync if staging repro shows regression. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ticket created: PERF-7321 (anchor instrumentation)
